title: Hospital facilities and biomedical engineering rounds
summary: Clinical engineering rounds in back-of-house areas only (no patients): a medical gas zone valve, infusion pumps due for maintenance, a blood bank refrigerator that goes into high-temperature alarm, and the emergency power transfer switch.
style: Unedited first-person snapshot from a head-mounted wearable camera at eye level, deep focus with everything sharp, no bokeh, in a hospital back-of-house corridor or equipment room, slightly off-level framing, bright clinical fluorescent lighting, light sensor noise, realistic, no people, no patients, no faces in frame.

Three infusion pumps on a metal shelf in a biomedical workshop; a white asset tag sticker on the front pump reads "BME-10442" in large black text.
Front of a glass-door blood bank refrigerator full of labeled blood bags; a label on the door reads "BBR-2"; its digital temperature display shows "4.1C" in green.
